hook.text: Governments spend trillions subsidizing energy—both fossil fuels and renewables receive enormous financial support.

buildup.text: Fossil fuel subsidies totaled $7 trillion in 2022 (IMF)—including direct payments and unpaid environmental costs.

discovery.text: Explicit subsidies keep fuel artificially cheap—benefiting consumers but discouraging efficiency and clean alternatives.

twist.text: Renewable subsidies are smaller but transformative—tariffs and tax credits jumpstarted solar and wind industries.

climax.text: Reforming fossil subsidies is politically explosive—protests erupted in Nigeria, Ecuador, and France over hikes.

punchline.text: Subsidize the old or fund the new—that's the policy choice.
